meta.title: Delete Account - CyberVPN
meta.description: Request manual privacy review for permanent deletion of your CyberVPN account and associated data.

title: Delete account request
subtitle: Submit a manual privacy review request for permanent account deletion

warning.title: Manual review before deletion
warning.message: CyberVPN reviews deletion requests before final processing. Verified deletions are targeted within 30 days, except records we must retain for payment, security, legal, fraud, backup or abuse handling.

items.accountData: Your account information and profile after the request is verified and processed
items.subscriptions: Active subscription handling, including any refund request, follows the Refund Policy and provider rules.
items.configs: VPN configurations and connection history covered by the deletion request
items.referrals: Referral data and earned rewards where retention is not legally or operationally required
items.support: Support tickets and communication history unless retention is required for privacy, legal, fraud or abuse handling

items.exportData: Request a data export if needed before deletion is finalized
items.cancelSubscriptions: Cancel any active subscriptions and review provider refund rules
items.useReferrals: Use any pending referral rewards that may be affected
items.saveConfigs: Save any custom VPN configurations you still need

alternativeOptions.title: Alternative options
alternativeOptions.description: If you're experiencing issues, consider these alternatives before requesting deletion:

items.pauseSubscription: Pause or change your subscription temporarily
items.contactSupport: Contact support for troubleshooting or billing help
items.changeSettings: Adjust your account, security or privacy settings

form.title: Confirm account deletion request
form.description: To submit a manual privacy review request, type DELETE below and confirm that you understand the impact.

reason.label: Reason for deletion (optional)
reason.placeholder: Help us improve by sharing why you're leaving

feedback.label: Additional feedback (optional)
feedback.placeholder: Any additional comments for privacy support...

confirmInput.label: Type DELETE to confirm
confirmInput.error: You must type DELETE to proceed

confirmation.label: I understand this request starts a permanent deletion review and may affect subscriptions, rewards and support history

success.title: Deletion request submitted
success.message: Your account deletion request is queued for manual privacy review.
success.details: Target fulfillment is within {days} days after verification. You can contact support with your reference before deletion is finalized.

error.title: Deletion request failed
error.message: We couldn't submit your deletion request. Please try again or contact support.
error.networkError: Network error. Please check your connection.
error.serverError: Server error. Please try again later.
error.unauthenticated: You must be logged in to request account deletion.
error.activeExists: An active deletion request already exists for this account.
error.validation: Check the form and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many privacy requests were created today. Try again later.
error.loadExisting: Could not check existing privacy requests. Refresh the page or contact support.

contact.title: Need help?
contact.description: If you have questions about account deletion or data privacy:

existing.title: Deletion request already open
existing.description: This account already has an active manual privacy review. Duplicate deletion requests are blocked until this request is completed or canceled.
